turns.user: If I want to keep an emergency buffer, how much of my take-home pay should I try not to touch each month?
turns.assistant: A common target is to leave at least 10–20% of take-home pay untouched if you can. If your budget is tight, even a smaller fixed amount is better than none, as long as it stays separate from normal spending. The key is to make the buffer consistent and only use it for true emergencies.
